text:
rachel_sales: Quick ping  LumenPay wants a short perf validation for their payments chat POC. Goals: sustain 200 qps, handle microbursts up to 650 qps for ~20s, and p95 <220ms for interactive replies. They also want quick hosted vs dedicated cost delta and the security checklist.
omar_se: Understood. Do we have sample token counts and model they want to test?
pak_perf: They sent samples: prompt ~45 tokens, response ~120 tokens -> ~165 tokens total avg. Model request: open-70b quant-8. Traffic mix: 60% short (chat), 40% longer completions.
omar_se: Proposed plan: A) warmup 6m at 30% target; B) steady 30m @200 qps; C) burst sequence: 4 bursts at 500/600/650/650 qps (20s each, 90s apart); D) cross-AZ fallback: 15% to fallback region for 12m. Provide runbook + cost appendix.
rachel_sales: They asked about cold-starts and KV cache priming. Add prewarm approach.
pak_perf: Prewarm: 1500 prefix primes + a 12m low qps fill to populate KV and kernels. Dedicated: suggest 10% warm standby; Hosted: maintain 3 warm workers for demo.
chris_ops: Sizing note: with quant-8 and KV caching on our runtime, steady 200 qps ~4 GPUs (A100 class) with continuous batching; to absorb 650 qps microbursts keep 7 GPUs or set autoscale to 8 with 75s cooldown. Hosted pricing multiplier ~1.9x.
omar_se: Measurement targets: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, average batch size distribution, queue length over time, GPU util, and sampled request traces (0.5%). Also collect network RTT for cross-AZ test.
zoe_sec: Security asks from LumenPay: SAML SSO, KMS for key management, tenant isolation notes, and audit logs for 180d if possible. If they want to test with live payment data we need signed DPA + security review.
rachel_sales: They want a fast ballpark monthly cost for 1.2M requests/month (avg 165 tokens/request) to compare Hosted vs small Dedicated commit.
chris_ops: Rough ballpark: Hosted inference ~ $4.5k/mo (depends on token billing & burst fees). Small Dedicated reserved amortized ~ $3k/mo plus infra ops. We'll produce a clear table after the run.
pak_perf: Loadgen we'll run (wrk-style + JS script):
```
wrk -t10 -c320 -d20s -R650 --script=payments_mix.lua --latency $TARGET
```
Steady runs use -R200 for 30m. Include our trace header x-rw-trace for token accounting.
rundown-bot: perf task #2207 queued: container built OK, scripts attached.
omar_se: Also plan to measure KV-cache on/off and quant 8 vs 16 to show tradeoffs. Include cost per million tokens estimate.
zoe_sec: Reminder: before any customer run with real data we must complete KMS exchange and have a signed DPA. For Hosted demo data is fine. I'll attach the exact clause.
rachel_sales: Timeline: LumenPay asked for deck mid-next-week. Can we run internal dry-run tomorrow afternoon and schedule customer demo Friday?
pak_perf: I can do dry-run tomorrow 14:00 PT. Need the sample corpus and API key corresponding to the exact model variant.
chris_ops: I'll provision test cluster: 7 x A10g equiv in us-west2, logs to secure bucket, autoscale policy set, creds in vault.
rundown-bot: perf task #2207 completed: results uploaded to secure storage.
pak_perf: Dry-run summary: steady 200 qps -> p95 ~205ms, p99 ~470ms. Burst 650 qps -> p95 peaked ~540ms, p99 ~1.15s. With KV-cache off steady p95 rose ~35%. GPU util avg ~75% sustained, spikes to 98% on bursts. Charts + CSV in secure link.
omar_se: Nice. Add one more sweep with reduced batch wait (512ms) to show p95 improvements at cost of throughput.
zoe_sec: I'll prepare the security checklist and required SAML/KMS artifacts. If they want 180d audit retention we'll need an add-on quote.
rachel_sales: Action items: 1) I'll send sample corpus link & confirm DPA path (EOD today). 2) chris will confirm infra and snapshot configs (by 10:00 PT tomorrow). 3) pak runs dry-run and posts slides. 4) zoe assembles security appendix.
chris_ops: Infra provisioned and prewired. Autoscale cooldown 75s.
pak_perf: I'll draft a one-pager runbook + 4-slide deck (observability charts, runtime knobs, cost appendix) after comparing KV on/off.
omar_se: Suggested runtime knobs for appendix: batch_target_ms=900, max_batch_tokens=28000, kv_cache=true, quant=8 for Dedicated.
rachel_sales: Great. I'll sync with LumenPay and tentatively book Friday 11:00 PT. Thanks team :thumbsup:
